title: The "Total CPU Use" widget's configuration doesn't work
line: Unticking Show Title on a Text Only system monitor widget in a panel now hides the sensor names and leaves only the values.
explanation: In a panel the Text Only face's compact representation showed every sensor's custom label or sensor name before its value and never looked at the Show Title setting, and since empty labels are not saved, clearing a label just fell back to the sensor name. So the 'Total Usage' text could neither be hidden nor removed, and Show Title did nothing in the panel. The compact representation now shows only the values when Show Title is off; with it on, nothing changes.

commits.message:
faces/textonly: Hide sensor names in panels when Show Title is off

The Text Only face in a panel always put each sensor's name before its
value, so unticking Show Title changed nothing there and the name could
not be removed. Show only the values when Show Title is off.

BUG: 501056

patches.diff:
From 69ff85b0cfc25ae3d8f175b6359d2a5d18ee4eee Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: =?UTF-8?q?Niccol=C3=B2=20Venerandi?= <niccolo@venerandi.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 02:49:07 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] faces/textonly: Hide sensor names in panels when Show Title
 is off

The Text Only face in a panel always put each sensor's name before its
value, so unticking Show Title changed nothing there and the name could
not be removed. Show only the values when Show Title is off.

BUG: 501056
---
 .../textonly/contents/ui/CompactRepresentation.qml            | 4 ++--
 1 file changed, 2 insertions(+), 2 deletions(-)

diff --git a/faces/facepackages/textonly/contents/ui/CompactRepresentation.qml b/faces/facepackages/textonly/contents/ui/CompactRepresentation.qml
index 7810fb86..c6b9af25 100644
--- a/faces/facepackages/textonly/contents/ui/CompactRepresentation.qml
+++ b/faces/facepackages/textonly/contents/ui/CompactRepresentation.qml
@@ -78,8 +78,8 @@ Faces.CompactSensorFace {
                 Layout.preferredWidth: root.horizontalFormFactor ? preferredWidth : minimumWidth
                 Layout.alignment: Qt.AlignLeft | Qt.AlignVCenter
 
-                name: root.controller.sensorLabels[modelData] || sensor.name
-                shortName: root.controller.sensorLabels[modelData] || sensor.shortName
+                name: root.controller.showTitle ? root.controller.sensorLabels[modelData] || sensor.name : ""
+                shortName: root.controller.showTitle ? root.controller.sensorLabels[modelData] || sensor.shortName : ""
                 value: sensor.formattedValue
                 color: lowPriority ? "transparent" : root.colorSource.map[modelData]
 
-- 
2.53.0

review.text: The patch reuses Show Title to drop every sensor name in the panel, which overloads an unrelated setting and leaves bare, meaningless values (the after shot is just '27.5%  1  16'); the fixer also doubts maintainers would want it. The cause named in the entry is that an explicitly cleared sensor label is not saved and falls back to the sensor name, and that is what should be fixed so users can hide or rename individual labels.
changes: Leave showTitle alone in CompactRepresentation.qml; instead make an explicitly empty custom sensor label (Sensors Details) persist and be honoured in libksysguard (controller/sensorLabels and the textonly face), so 'Total Usage' alone can be removed
Redo before/after with that flow (clear the 'Total Usage' label, other labels kept)
